info.name: Pokemon Ruby Sapphire API
info.description: Final Project Backend Basic. Jalankan folder berurutan (00 -> 10). Folder 11 adalah alur demo presentasi yang berdiri sendiri. Variabel pokemonId, trainerId, ownedPokemonId, dan boxPokemonId terisi otomatis oleh request Create.

exec: pm.test("Stats are calculated", function () { pm.expect(json.data.maxHp > 0 && json.data.hp === json.data.maxHp).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Has pagination info", function () { pm.expect(json.pagination.page === 1 && json.pagination.limit === 10).to.be.true; });
pm.test("At most 2 items", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length <= 2 && json.pagination.limit === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("60 species, 20 per page", function () { pm.expect(json.pagination.totalItems === 60 && json.data.length === 20).to.be.true; });
pm.test("5 items on page 2", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length === 5 && json.pagination.page === 2).to.be.true; });

item.name: Path param: get Trainer by id

exec: pm.test("Has party and box count", function () { pm.expect(json.data.partyCount === 0 && json.data.boxCount === 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("No trainer, no storage", function () { pm.expect(json.data.trainerId === null && json.data.storage === null).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Released", function () { pm.expect(json.data.trainerId === null && json.data.storage === null).to.be.true; });
pm.test("1 in party", function () { pm.expect(json.data.partyCount === 1 && json.data.boxCount === 0).to.be.true; });

item.name: Create Pokemon for Trainer (#7, party full -> box)

exec: pm.test("No trainer", function () { pm.expect(json.data.trainerId === null && json.data.storage === null).to.be.true; });

item.name: 11 - Demo Presentasi

exec: pm.test("Treecko berevolusi ke Grovyle", function () { pm.expect(json.data.evolvesTo.name === "Grovyle").to.be.true; });
pm.test("Party penuh, masuk box", function () { pm.expect(json.data.storage === "box").to.be.true; });

item.name: 12. Pindahkan Pokemon ke-7 ke party (ada slot)
14. Query: Pokemon May urut level tertinggi

exec: pm.test("3 item, 7 total, 3 halaman", function () { pm.expect(json.count === 3 && json.pagination.totalItems === 7 && json.pagination.totalPages === 3).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Ada data statistik", function () { pm.expect(json.data.totalPokemon >= 7 && json.data.byType.Grass >= 1).to.be.true; });

item.name: 20. Bersihkan data demo (hapus Trainer dan Pokemon demo)

exec: ids.forEach(function (id) { pm.sendRequest({ url: base + "/pokemon/" + id, method: "DELETE" }, function () {}); });
